name: Impetus of Hecate
description:
You have dominion over [dark-gray]past[/dark-gray], [brown]present[/brown], and [gray]future[/gray], granting the following spell effects:

  • [dark-gray]Past[/dark-gray]: You reflect after every 3rd spell cast, causing your next spell tome swing to recast your last spell at no XP cost.

  • [brown]Present[/brown]: You gain 25% runic spell power, and [effect:mag][dark-gray]magic weapon[/dark-gray][/effect] kills collect loot and XP.

  • [gray]Future[/gray]: You can sneak swing a spell tome to scry, casting its rightmost spell regardless of your current selection.

[dark-gray]"Three paths, intertwined. Master this, master them."[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Spell tomes, Hawking Warp, Newton Meteors
